notes.title: Roll Control Dungeon Update
notes.content:
Hello Rollers!

Some new updates to share in the Dungeon Update Level!

- Meet the Blue Skull!
- Watch out for falling Traps!
-improved Infinite Island mode now tracks the high score, has a new road section and more music
-Minor tweaks and fixes

notes.title: NYC Update
notes.content:
New Enemies and Tiles! Take to the streets and dodge oncoming traffic like a true New Yorker. 4 new tiles and 3 new cars are in the editor for you to build more challenges.

new level! visit the new NYC Update level on the select screen. 

New Help Menu! Are you new to Roll Control? Now you can learn more about connecting to the Roll Controller app and playing with your balance. Click Help on the Select screen for more.
updated calibration options

Small feature! coins created in editor mode now have "magnetism" and fly to the ball to be picked up when nearby

Small update! calibrate level now has new preset options for sensitivity and boardshape

bug fixes! Fixed level freezing in Story Mode, misc fixes
